description: A Popup is siblings-deep like a Page: its own Container tree, FieldMapping/Property config (e.g. title), and Style — referenced by id from an OpenPopup EventMapping or a kf.app.page.openPopup(...) call.
notes: FieldMapping can be owned by a Popup directly (parent key "Popup"), exactly like it can be owned by a Container or a Menu — the same FieldMapping/Property node shape is reused across all three owner kinds, only the back-ref key name changes.

The Popup's OWN root Container is Type:"Popup" (not "Body" like a page's root, not "Component"/"Container" like a nested layout node) — a distinct fourth Container Type value alongside Body/Container/Component.

A Popup carries its own Style (Popup-owned) in addition to its root Container's Style (Container-owned) — two separate Style nodes for two separate concerns (the popup chrome itself vs its content area).
Content beyond the title (buttons, fields, repeaters, anything) goes inside Container_Sample01's own Container::Container tree, using the exact same widget shapes as any page body.
